brief: One minimal UI style board; no invented gameplay imagery.

attempts.purpose: Initial generation; rejected because the background had transparency artifacts.
attempts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Primary request: ONE minimalist 2D UI component style board for the Chinese desktop Sokoban puzzle game "空间站重启". The user rejected earlier concepts because they looked like invented gameplay screenshots and wants a much simpler UI direction. Show the interface components themselves on a completely plain warm-white canvas. This is a flat graphic UI design study, not gameplay, not a website.
Format: one landscape 16:9 image, generously spaced, crisp readable Chinese typography. Four small coherent UI studies in a quiet 2-by-2 grid, separated only by whitespace and very subtle short horizontal rules. Top row main menu and gameplay information bar; bottom row text-only level list and a completion dialog. Make actual component examples reasonably large, no crowded reference sheet, no color swatches or font specimens.
Visual system: ultra restrained flat design, warm-white #F7F7F4 background, near-black #282C30 text, gray #858A8F secondary text, very light gray #E4E5E2 hairlines. Exactly ONE muted burnt-orange #DA7848 accent, used only for a primary button, selected row indicator, and a tiny completion checkmark. No gradients, bloom, transparency effects, shadows, texture, beveled edges, metal, glows, glass, or decorative sci-fi motifs. Small 4px corner radii, mostly square geometry, no pill chips or oversized card containers. Modern humanist Chinese sans serif, large headings, comfortable leading, consistently aligned to a grid, substantial whitespace. Minimal simple 1.5px line icons only where they explain an action. UI visual language should be feasible in a modest indie Unity game.
CONTENT AND COMPOSITION:
Upper left study, small gray label "主菜单": a simple medium-large single-line title "空间站重启". No tagline or English subtitle. Under it a single medium-size flat burnt-orange rectangular primary button "开始游戏". Below are three unboxed text actions on separate evenly spaced lines: "选择关卡", "设置", "退出". No extra labels.
Upper right study, small gray label "游戏信息": a compact understated horizontal HUD strip, with "02 借电开路" on its own heading line; beneath, inline metrics "供电 1/2", "移动 24", "推动 8" separated by light vertical dividers. Beneath this strip, a quiet row of simple text shortcuts, small square outlined keycaps paired with the labels: "Z" then "撤销", "R" then "重开", "V" then "视角", "Esc" then "暂停". No invented game scene behind it, only blank canvas.
Lower left study, small gray label "关卡列表": three simple text rows with fine separators, no pictures or cards. Rows read exactly "01  唤醒维修区", "02  借电开路", "03  重启主核心". Second row selected using only a narrow orange vertical marker and a very subtle light gray row background. All three available, no padlocks, stars, ranking or progress meter.
Lower right study, small gray label "完成弹窗": an unembellished white rectangle with one faint gray 1px border, minimal 4px corners, no shadow. Inside small burnt-orange checkmark, bold heading "维修区已通电"; beneath simple secondary statistics "移动 8 · 推动 3". At the bottom a small orange primary button "下一关", and two secondary unboxed text controls "重玩" and "返回选关". Precise interior padding.
Absolute constraints: NO 3D graphics, NO robots, NO characters, NO energy cubes, NO isometric objects, NO dioramas, NO level previews, NO gameplay images, NO photographs, NO space imagery, NO backgrounds other than plain white, NO illustrated scenery, NO device frames. Do not emulate an actual screenshot or add a large empty gameplay viewport. No title across the whole design board and no extra decorative typography. Only the requested Chinese strings and input keys. Overall result should be quiet, simple, mature and practical, with a restrained accent and only the essential UI elements.

attempts.purpose: Repair background while preserving the minimal UI layout.
attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Repair this UI style board. The source image has a corrupted transparent background; reconstruct a CLEAN FULLY OPAQUE warm-white board. EVERY background area must be a single solid warm-white color #F7F7F4, alpha 255 everywhere. Output a flat opaque rectangular image with a painted white background. All text must be solid dark graphite. Remove all black background, chromatic noise, jagged edges and transparency artifacts completely.
Preserve the source's four UI component groups and all their Chinese content, placement, scale, generous spacing and the restrained orange accent. Top-left main menu with title "空间站重启", primary button "开始游戏", then "选择关卡", "设置", "退出". Top-right compact HUD titled "02 借电开路", metrics "供电 1/2", "移动 24", "推动 8", and key hints "Z 撤销", "R 重开", "V 视角", "Esc 暂停". Lower-left list with "01 唤醒维修区", "02 借电开路", "03 重启主核心"; second row has a light gray fill and thin orange left marker. Lower-right simple bordered completion dialog, small orange checkmark, "维修区已通电", "移动 8 · 推动 3", orange "下一关" button and secondary "重玩", "返回选关".
Small gray group labels: "主菜单", "游戏信息", "关卡列表", "完成弹窗".
Crisp modern Chinese sans serif type. Flat solid orange button fills #DA7848, subtle light gray rules. Very understated 4px corners. Uniform opaque white page. Focus only on the UI. Scene-free, object-free, character-free graphic design. No lighting, gradients or shadows. Keep the minimalist layout of the source. The background must be visibly white, NOT transparent.
